text_block_list.text:
I may have lost last time... But this one
I'll win for
sure!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Of course. I'm not giving anyone the
chance to
look down on me.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I'll put on an amazing display, take first
place...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: And show them all I can do it!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
